notes: The measured depth of the twelve markets of the v1 demo pack (data/demo_v1) on 2026-09-10: bars, prints, traded bars and news items. Every one of them reports n_trades = 0 and traded_bars = 0, and data/demo_v1 has no news directory at all, so n_news is 0 on all twelve. This is the measurement behind ruling R264's sentence that a showcase pack must carry a research market's depth: the pack the ruling replaces carries bars and nothing else, and tests/test_showcase.py asserts that check_showcase_depth refuses all twelve rather than accepting eleven of them.
